repairs: Balance and randomize hidden mechanisms across subject runs.
Randomly permute hypothesis labels and presentation order to reduce author-intent leakage.
Request a posterior distribution over live models rather than a forced single-model choice.
Score forecast calibration across the balanced allocation, not against one fixed lucky outcome.
Derive contact value from frozen priors, likelihoods, costs, and expected information gain.
Permit an investigate-further decision when the selected observation leaves consequential ambiguity.
Replace ceilinged transfer and proxy worlds with variants that leave at least two plausible actions before contact.
qualification_requirements: An honest uncertain control must beat a lucky overconfident control across the balanced allocation.
A contact maximizing expected information gain must beat a salient but non-discriminating contact.
Relabeling hypotheses must not materially change condition rankings.
The evaluator must distinguish correct scoped transfer from both global overgeneralization and refusal to transfer.
The evaluator must distinguish stopping after decisive evidence from premature stopping and ritual continuation.
promotion_block: No intervention may be promoted from LL-0002 scores. EVAL-0002 must first pass synthetic and real-control qualification on a fresh CHALLENGE allocation.
